title: LLM Policy for Rust Compiler
summary: This is a policy document from the Rust project establishing guidelines for the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) in Rust compiler development. The document addresses how AI-generated code contributions should be handled, reviewed, and integrated into the compiler codebase to maintain quality standards.
problem_solved: Establishes clear guidelines for using AI-generated code in Rust compiler development to maintain code quality and contributor accountability.
why_valuable: Sets a precedent for responsible LLM usage in critical infrastructure projects, providing clarity for contributors while maintaining Rust's high code quality standards.
